Controversy in Serbia!? Belgrade unveil New Stefan Nemanja Monument. In this vlog I go to check out the Stefan Nemanja monument which was unveiled last week in the capital city of Serbia, Belgrade. Some Serbians love the new monument and some don't. A lot of friends from Serbia were saying I need to check it out so here's the video.
